_comment: oh_dear's SOUND v1 — dub techno requiem, 108, G minor. Saint Helena as dub: chords dissolving in delay fog (skank), a deep walking sub (oazoor bank+inhabit), hiss and swell like the Atlantic, a dry clock (tick) for history passing. THEMES, orchestrated across registers (theGodInUrhead move): ohdear = the falling sigh bb->g (pluck / bell / and answered low by the swell chords); cockerel = the rising crow g-bb-d-g (bright at the marooning, a ghost sine at the dream and the dawn); emperor = a descending d-c-bb-a-g march (horn for Waterloo, deep for the unnamed stone); amahubo = the ONE lift into Bb major (relative major — the island brightened from inside its own key) with a pentatonic call over it. brass = the boer pawnshop band (crushed square oompah). The match: magma (subHard mold in G) + boil (16th acid bank walk, filter riding open) + per-bar impact booms = the world trembling. Moves spent: riff bank walk + inhabit + @ (oazoor, runtime-verified), swung hats by @ (fenton), filter-as-energy sine.range (switch-angel), one-cell orchestration (theGodInUrhead).  ERUPTION+BROADCAST pass: the back half now burns. quake/demera/firebreath/brimstone/column/collapse/ashfall are the eruption (the Meskel bonfire that reveals what is buried); bonechoir is the amahubo voicing distorted — the essay cut 'where enough bones learn to sing', so the music performs it instead of saying it; cockerelburn is the crow surviving the fire. Then the EAS: saheader is the SAME data burst (an evocation at true mark/space pitches, deliberately NOT a valid header), attention is the exact 853+960 Hz two-tone left unresolved against G minor because it does not belong to the music, carrier is the empty channel the robot speaks over and the last thing that dies. ADDITIVE — no tuned instrument was touched. (saheader carries NO envelope on purpose: a freq-driven synth with .decay().sustain(0) and no attack/release renders silent in strudel 1.0.3 — and a data burst wants to be gapless anyway, so the bits butt against each other and click, which is exactly the sound.)

figure.note: our own cut — the maimed man, drawn limb by limb (ffmpeg drawtext); the wav is silence, the film IS the sample

magma: note("g0 g0 d1 g0 f0 g0 [d1 f0] g0").s("sawtooth").shape(0.45).lpf(650).lpq(5).gain(0.8)
boil: note(pick(["[g2 bb2 g2 d3 g2 bb2 f2 d3]*2", "[g2 bb2 c3 d3 eb3 d3 bb2 g2]*2", "[g2 g2 bb2 g2 d3 g2 f2 g2]*2"], "<0 0 1 2>")).s("sawtooth").shape(0.25).lpf(sine.range(500,2600).slow(8)).lpq(6).release(0.12).gain(0.34)
